title: Chapter close — Stochastic mechanics
html:
Chapter close — Stochastic mechanics.

This closes the stochastic-mechanics chapter. The Markov closure map, \varphi_q AJ machinery, Lusztig canonical basis at q = 1, and reverse limit q \to \infty assembled here give the substrate-level stochastic content that the classical-limit and information-theoretic chapters consume as input. The closing results land the bridge between the Markov closure map and the classical-limit construction explicitly.

The next chapter extracts the hyperbolic-volume content that pairs with the substrate-level mass spectrum. The subsequent chapters specialise the duality to atomic isotopes and the \beta-decay Q-value predictions.
